svg.title: Zephyr eBPF architecture overview
svg.desc: Slide-friendly architecture diagram showing bundle authoring, control surfaces, common runtime core, native event sources, and downstream consumers.

text.tspan: A single runtime-loaded bundle model: authoring and control stay outside the hot path, while backends converge on the same verifier,

Control operations stay off-path; runtime execution converges through one shared dispatch and VM core.
